name: Vraed Halman
found: Vraed's Fighting Hall, training alone in the yard at dawn.
appearance: Mid-40s. Two fingers missing, left hand. Bandua's mark tattooed on right forearm.
and_yet: Ink-stained fingers on the maimed hand.
sayings: I’m the only one here taking this seriously.
wants: The seasonal raid. Schismatics gone before Rakhmoth.
dreams: His sons leading raids after him.
oddly_also: Has never lost a fighter under his command.
family: Wife Sera; two sons of raiding age; two younger daughters.
anecdotes: Lost two fingers to a goblin and killed it with the same hand.
tragedies: Lost a close friend when a Schismatic-influenced steading refused to send warning of a raid.
